about_the_game:
Variety of Characters

Choose from a wide range of heroes, each with their own unique ability.  Raise exploding zombies as the Gravedigger, build auto turrets as the Goblineer, fire arrows that curve and seek enemies as the Onna-Musha, set fires as the Pyro Maniac, go into a teleporting attack frenzy as Poof.  The list of heroes is 20+ with more planned for future updates!

Power Points

Feel like you're taking too much damage?  Not doing enough damage yourself?  Having trouble keeping your health up?  With the power points system, you can freely place points you earn where you feel like you need them.  Each character's natural strengths and weaknesses can be altered with the power points system to create the playstyle you want!

Random Patrol Missions

In the Hall of Heroes, a hero can choose to take a patrol mission which will assign a task for random unlocked location.  These missions are optional and consist of simple things such as eliminating a number of enemies or structures or collecting a number of fragments.  These missions reward the hero with a large number of fragments and a portal that can be used to return to the Hall of Heroes.

Crystal Fragments

The main currency heroes will collect is called fragments.  Live until a portal opens or wipe out the entire stage to extract with the fragments.  Dying will result in dropping any fragments you are holding, but don't worry because you can store fragments back at the Hall of Heroes, if you make it back alive! Fragments are used to unlock new stages, new characters, and temporary enhancements!

Risk vs Reward

To earn fragments faster, and to increase the challenge in any stage, you can spend a small bit of fragments to increase the tier of the next stage you enter.  Each tier increase comes with increased amount of enemies along with increased damage and health the enemies start with!  Every 10 tiers will add a random modifier that adds a unique twist!

 

Features

  • 20+ Heroes with varying play styles and abilities.

  • 5 different stages to destroy.

  • Fine tune your stats with power points.

  • Enhanced enemies have a chance to drop crystals that upgrade stats.

  • Enemies and structures become stronger with every structure destroyed.

  • Collect crystal fragments to unlock characters, stages, and enhancements.

  • Eliminate crystal runners to earn cosmic powers. 

  • Acquire random missions to earn extra fragments.

  • Increase the tier of a stage to increase fragment drops and add modifiers.

  • Survive to store fragments at the heroes' base, the Hall of Heroes!

  • After destroying everything, face a super villain to complete your mission.

  • Roguelike, after each stage your stats return to their initial values.

content_descriptors.notes: Enemies blow up into bloody bits.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Athlon X4 | Intel Core i5 4460
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 950 | AMD R7 370
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Unleash chaos in this fast-paced action RPG twin-stick roguelike where you take control of a diverse roster of badass superheroes, each with unique powers and playstyles. Tear through destructible stages and obliterate hordes of enemies!
